title: Finite free slice complex reconstructed from terminal sections
statement: Let W be a scheme and U an affine open [def-pc-scheme]. Let K be an integer cochain complex of module sheaves on the localized open site of U [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For r: Z -> N suppose K^j is isomorphic to the free module sheaf indexed by ULift(Fin(r(j))) in each degree [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let F evaluate at the terminal slice object (U,id). Let A = Gamma(W,U), P = F(K), and S be tilde on Spec(A) followed by restriction along the affine chart hU.isoSpec.hom and the inverse of Modules.overEquiv U [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model]. Then S(P) is isomorphic to K as an actual cochain complex. No support bound, K-flatness, derived localization, or point is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01IB (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent), natural affine counit, applied termwise

proof.text: Compose chart restriction and inverse slice equivalences to E. The fully faithful tilde left adjoint composed with E.toAdjunction gives F = tilde followed by E.functor left adjoint to H = E.inverse followed by moduleSpecGamma. TildeFinsupp and mapFreeIso identify F of the finite free section module with the slice finite free sheaf, using the transported unit isomorphism. Each K term lies in the essential image of F, so adj.isIso_counit_app_of_iso makes the counit invertible on that term.

Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies inverse chart restriction with chart pushforward. Construct a natural isomorphism from its sections to terminal slice evaluation: isoSpec_hom_appTop cancels GammaSpecIso, and the presheaf map along the isomorphism from (U,id) to the top slice object cancels U.topIso. The module scalar law and presheaf morphism naturality prove this is a module natural isomorphism. Map it and the counit to complexes. The counit is invertible componentwise and commutes with every differential by naturality, giving the stated actual complex isomorphism. The construction works for rank zero, zero rings, empty opens and unbounded complexes.

theorem affineFree_terminalSections_reconstruction
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (r : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{v} (Fin (r j))))) :
    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
        ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) :=
      SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
    Nonempty (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≅ K)
